question: The 2026-08-15 lane-9 bisect named trust 80c7e86f55 as the single cause of 38 lost `agreed` verdicts and judged the loss an OVER-APPROXIMATION. Verify that verdict independently, then fix it in the PRODUCER and measure whether the 38 return with nothing else moving.

independent_verdict_check.method: reproduced from scratch in this lane, not inherited
independent_verdict_check.control_reproduces_recorded_census_diges: yes — byte for byte (coverage 5b3c183c…, trust-ir.txt e02c3422…, trust-ir.bin 029d2cd3…)
independent_verdict_check.bodies_reproduced_in_isolation: the exact source of MAX_BUNDLE_NAME_BYTES / width_mask / get_int_val::{closure#0} / OriginTrust::needs_recheck lifted verbatim into an 27-line file: agreed(1)/agreed(5)/agreed(7) under the control driver, all not-run `undef ty bool` under the subject driver — same sample counts as the real rows
independent_verdict_check.built_mir_shape_measured: -Zdump-mir over that file: every one of the four cleanup targets is `bbN (cleanup): { resume; }` — statement-free lone-resume, the shape `mir_differential::benign_unwind` already classes benign
independent_verdict_check.rustc_removes_it_measured: width_mask at -Cpanic=abort: pad present through 2-2-004 ElaborateDrops, GONE from 2-2-006 AbortUnwindingCalls onward. RemoveNoopLandingPads::is_enabled is `sess.panic_strategy().unwinds()` so it does not run under -Cpanic=abort; its own doc says it replaces jumps to noop pads with UnwindAction::Continue.
independent_verdict_check.honest_correction_to_the_prior_report: for a CTFE const-init body the pad is NOT removed by rustc — the const pipeline ends at 3-2-001 CtfeLimit and never reaches RemoveNoopLandingPads (3-2-027). The prior lane's blanket 'rustc deletes it' holds for runtime fns, not for the 33 const bodies. The verdict is unchanged: under -Cpanic=abort the edge is still unreachable behaviour, benign_unwind still accepts the shape, and the Resume lowering is still an ill-typed zero-value exit.
independent_verdict_check.verdict: CONFIRMED — the loss is an over-approximation, not a soundness correction

fix.what: one predicate, `modelled_cleanup_target`, shared by `terminator_successors` and `wire_cleanup_edge`; it declines the unwind edge when the cleanup target is the built-phase no-op landing pad (`is_noop_landing_pad`: no statements + Terminator::Resume). The pad is then neither kept reachable nor wired, so no orphan block and no demonic `Undef bool` selector exists to classify.
fix.what_it_is_NOT: the havoc check was NOT relaxed. `differential.rs` (undef_is_dead_seed / classify_undefs_traced), `crate_module.rs`, `to_mir.rs`, `mir_differential.rs`, `flip_registry.rs` all keep blob identity; the interpreter (first-party/trust-ir) never moved.

fixed.built_from: $HOME/trust-lane10 (git worktree at 2d7e094f22; first-party materialised READ-ONLY via `git archive` at that revision's pins — no submodule HEAD in the user's tree moved)
fixed.selftest: UNPROVEN — all three drivers register the same ten perturbation classes, so they are told apart behaviourally (the 53-row `undef ty bool` signature) and by the recorded blobs

compilers.why_measured_at_2d7e094f22_and_not_trust: trust origin/main (ab69dc4318) moves NINE first-party pins including first-party/trust-ir, which owns the interpreter this gate uses. Measuring there would reintroduce every confound the lane-9 A/B removed. The four behaviour-carrying functions (`call_uses_flat_total_summary`, `terminator_successors`, `wire_cleanup_edge`, `lower_terminator`) are BYTE-IDENTICAL at 2d7e094f22 and origin/main, the patch applies to origin/main with pure line offsets, and the resulting function texts are byte-identical to the measured ones.

design.non_incremental: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 + `cargo clean -p clean-kernel` before every run; a lane-owned CARGO_TARGET_DIR per arm

restored.extra_row_moved: env::native_reducers_bool_ext::nat_gcd — a GAIN (not-run -> agreed on 25 sampled inputs), not caused by this patch: lane 9 measured it appearing at 39a39ffa0e (the culprit's PARENT) and being masked by the culprit. The fix unmasks it.

result.the_21_flipping_bodies: all 21 EXECUTE again — verdict `agreed`, samples>=1, detail 'THIR-trust-ir == MIR-trust-ir on N sampled input(s)'. Re-verified, not re-labelled.
result.profile_independence: the -O0 and -O3 coverage.json are BYTE-IDENTICAL within every arm (control 5b3c183c…, subject a59cc78f…, fixed df3f1a9f…). The oracle is built from `mir_built`, before optimisation.
